title: Independent code review
problem: Authors cannot independently assess their own implementation.
rationale: Required review gates remain independent of lint/test success; author and descendants cannot approve their own work.
applicability: Behavior changes and the exact candidate required by the independent review policy.
baseline_policy: No legacy waiver for required verification or release prerequisites.

target_check.deterministic: existing review store has independent attributed/lineage-checked verdict on exact tip, with structured selected-practice assessments tied to candidate inputs.
target_check.reviewer: correctness, design, tests, security and compatibility.

target_check.configuration: Project-approved native configuration, immutable source/tool/config pins and applicable evidence mappings; Required review gates remain independent of lint/test success; author and descendants cannot approve their own work.

expected_evidence: **D:** existing review store has independent attributed/lineage-checked verdict on exact tip, with structured selected-practice assessments tied to candidate inputs. **R:** correctness, design, tests, security and compatibility.
